new: Ward, MLA, MP and zone pages: open reports by size, how long they have waited, a weekly trend, repeat hot spots, and every report as a photo grid you can sort and filter.
Reporting starts with the camera, then asks how bad it is, the type of waste, the problem and a landmark, one screen at a time, with a final check before you submit.
Sizes are compared to everyday things, like an auto-rickshaw. Fallen trees get their own descriptions.
"Not garbage?": stand at the spot, photograph what is really there and pick a reason. We review it before the report comes off the map.
Verifying a cleanup needs you within 100 m with a live photo. Every verification photo carries a strip with the time, ward and location.
Volunteer communities: find a group cleaning up your ward, or register your own. Listings are reviewed before they go live.
The whole app is available in Hindi.
Weekly digest signup, ward leaderboard, city officials, filters by waste type and problem, and search for places, wards and officials.
fixed: Reports now say "Seen by N people" instead of a bare number.

new: 36 MCG wards on the map, with the councillor, zone officers and MLA for every spot.
Your location is detected the moment you take the photo, and the report shows who must clean it.
Launch: report garbage with a photo, confirm reports you have seen too, verify cleanups, analytics and open data.
